meaning: Tool-call DFA non-resetting concatenation vs. explicit reset-token gluing benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 82): on the 4-state lock/commit/release DFA with accepting F = {q0_idle, q2_done}, Phase 1 separates direct concatenation of two non-resetting segments [acquire, commit] landing in q3_err (Delta_E = -1), Phase 2 separates late reset appended only to segment 2 (Delta_E = -1), and Phase 3 verifies explicit reset-token gluing [acquire, commit, release] on every segment returning to q0_idle (Delta_E = 0).
